title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler’s Course Record
items.text: Scottie Scheffler matched the TPC Southwind course record with a 9-under 61 featuring 11 birdies to lead the FedEx St. Jude Championship at -11 after the second round.

items.headline: Robert MacIntyre Withdraws
items.text: Robert MacIntyre withdrew before Round 2 of the FedEx St. Jude Championship due to a knee injury after opening with a 12-over 82.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Dating Rumors
items.text: Rumors suggest Bryson DeChambeau is dating Canadian model and former hockey goalie Mikayla Demaiter, fueled by social media posts at LIV Golf New York, though neither has confirmed.
